arguments.prompt: Create a CORRECTIVE native pixel-art source atlas of Maximillion Pegasus AND Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon, exactly the same appearance as attached actual original atlas. Pegasus is the silver-haired adult duelist in a red long tailcoat, white gloves, blue bow and dark trousers. His complete blue-eyed WHITE CARTOON dragon is compact at right with full head, body, wings, legs and tail. No ordinary realistic Blue-Eyes replacement. EVERY drawing is ONE COMPLETE DUO UNIT with full human on LEFT and full named partner on RIGHT; every cell has BOTH characters with full heads, all feet and complete equipment. EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS by 6 ROWS = 24 complete distinct DUO drawings. Never omit either member, merge figures, hide the human behind a monster, replace a body by a VFX, or omit the companion during running/recoil. Every four pictures form a genuinely different four-pose sequence, not cloned whole bodies. ROW1: ROUND DEFEAT: four different tired but intact poses, both full bodies remain present. ROW2: FINALE: four different prepare/wind-up/mouth-open THIRD/recover poses. ROW3: DEFEAT: four other exhausted low poses with both full bodies, no injury. ROW4: SUPER: four different anticipation/preparation/mouth-open THIRD/recovery poses. ROW5: RUN: four different real locomotion steps for BOTH full Pegasus and full Toon dragon. FINAL ROW: four separate calm FULLY UPRIGHT STANDING idle poses of the COMPLETE DUO at the same true body scale; this row is calibration only, excluded from production pose counts. Keep the natural kneeling/leaning poses shorter than standing, not stretched. Actual attacks have ONLY a tiny blue point of light attached to the dragon mouth in the THIRD picture; no long beam/flame, detached projectile, victim, aura, music effect or smoke. Human commands only; magical power is not emitted by the human hand. Same source palette, limb count and relative body proportions in all drawings. Compact units using less than65% cell width with generous empty transparent gutters and20pixel outer margins. Transparent background, no scenery, floor, shadow, text, grid, labels or additional character. Practical non-graphic fictional game sprites.
